Motion on strengthening Singapore's economic competitiveness as a globally connected aviation, maritime and logistics hub

7 July 2026 motion-2996, motion-2998

A Motion moved by the Chairperson of the Government Parliamentary Committee for Transport, Ms Tin Pei Ling, affirming the importance of strengthening Singapore's long-term economic competitiveness through international cooperation, frontier technologies and world-class infrastructure, debated by Members and resolved by the House.

The transcript sets out concrete measures: MOT plans to invest $800 million over the next five years on transport research and innovation, and a manpower transition package for taxi and private-hire drivers includes place-and-train Career Conversion Programmes launching in the third quarter of this year, a $20-per-hour training incentive from January 2027, and a one-stop information webpage. Autonomous shuttles already run in Punggol and autonomous buses will be piloted on Service 400 in Marina Bay and Service 191 in One-North.
